daily.today_energy: Mercury's got you feeling sharp and introspective today. It's giving quiet confidence—the kind where you don't need to prove anything to anyone. Trust that internal compass of yours; it's been steering you right.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the energy shift in you, even if you're not broadcasting it. Whether single or coupled, lean into authenticity over perfection. Real connection happens when you stop rehearsing and just *be*.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is your superpower rn, but don't let perfectionism become a speed bump. Small wins count. Focus on finishing one thing fully rather than juggling five half-done projects. Progress > perfection.
daily.health: Your nervous system might feel a lil overstimulated—consider grounding yourself with something tactile. A walk, journaling, or even just touching different textures can help reset. Listen to what your body's actually asking for.

weekly.overview: This week's energy invites you to release perfectionism and embrace the beautiful mess of being human. Mercury's vibes are helping you communicate what's been stuck in your throat. Trust the unfolding.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or single, vulnerability is your superpower rn. Stop overthinking those texts and let yourself feel without analyzing. Someone's noticing your realness, and that's what magnetizes connection.
weekly.career: Your organizational skills are about to shine, but the real magic happens when you collaborate instead of controlling every detail. Let others surprise you with their approaches. Innovation loves a shared workspace.
weekly.health: Your body's asking you to slow down and actually listen to what it needs. Move in ways that feel good, not punishing. Hydration and sleep are your quiet power moves this week—treat them like non-negotiable rituals.
